source_title: India ends FIFA U-15 World Cup 2026 campaign with 2-1 win over Cuba - Sportstar
source_excerpt:
Bibiano Fernandes’ side was on the charge from the outset and needed less than a minute to take the lead, and ultimately ended its campaign with a win. | Photo Credit: AIFF Media
India ended its campaign at the FIFA U-15 World Cup & Festival 2026 on a winning note, defeating Cuba 6-4 in the 87th-place play-off at the Hovsan Competition Complex Pitch 1B in Baku on Friday, October 30, 2026.
Victor Lalawmpuia, Nibas Meetei Wahengbam and R. Lalremruatfela scored twice each as the Blue Colts won their 10th and final fixture of the tournament. India built a commanding 6-1 advantage before Cuba struck three late goals to narrow the margin.
Bibiano Fernandes’ side was on the charge from the outset and needed less than a minute to take the lead. Lalawmpuia stole possession from Cuba’s central defender, evaded a challenge and calmly placed his shot into the bottom-right corner.
India doubled their advantage in the sixth minute through a well-worked move down the left. Lalremruatfela and Muhammad Sohil Khan combined before the latter delivered a cross across the face of goal, beyond the reach of the Cuban defence and goalkeeper. An unmarked Nibas arrived at the far post to tap home.
Cuba responded by testing Dhannya Desai from distance and close range, but the India goalkeeper produced several important saves to preserve his side’s two-goal cushion.

India extended its lead in the 12th minute following a set piece.
Sohil floated a free-kick into the area from the left, and although Cuba cleared the initial delivery, Nara Meitei Loushambam sent the ball back into the penalty box. Lalremruatfela was left unmarked and tapped it home to make it 3-0.
Cuba pulled a goal back in the 19th minute after an error in the Indian defence, but the Blue Colts returned with renewed attacking intent and restored their three-goal advantage in the 22nd minute. Nibas struck powerfully from long range to score his second of the match.
Lalawmpuia followed suit a minute later. Receiving possession well outside the penalty area, he held off a Cuban challenge before trying his luck with his left foot. His shot took a deflection, looping into the air before dipping beyond the goalkeeper’s reach to make it 5-1.
Lalremruatfela then completed his brace in the 27th minute as India capitalised on more slack Cuban defending. Left unmarked, he collected Desai’s goal kick and beat the goalkeeper with a powerful left-footed finish for India’s sixth.
Cuba continued to seek a response, but Desai remained alert, making further saves before being replaced by Jenit Ningthoujam.
The Caribbean side reduced the deficit in the 33rd minute from the penalty spot. Cuba then scored two more in the 34th and 39th minutes.
The late rally, however, came too late to overturn India’s advantage. The Blue Colts held on through the remaining moments to secure the win.
